name: Potion Infusion: Frostbite rests target Potion and tags it INFUSION_FROSTBITE
notes: Potion Infusion: Frostbite's element is WATER, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real WATER champion (Spirit of Water), reused from potion-infusion-seal-rest. Distilled Water (a POTION-subtype ITEM) is seeded directly onto the field as the rest target. Without a [Class Bonus] discount, the full 1-reserve cost is paid, then both players decline the EffectStackActiveResponse opportunity window before the seeded Potion is chosen. Resting it adds the INFUSION_FROSTBITE turn-effect tag; only the base rest+tag effect is covered, not the granted On-Sacrifice ability itself (which requires actually sacrificing the Potion and dealing water damage).

rulesClauses: Rest target Potion. If you do, it gains an On Sacrifice ability until end of turn.
